sources.text: GLM-4-9B BASE 8K, not chat/128K/all GLM. Independent BF16 mathematical/materialized attention reference of the SDPA-selected structure; NOT a literal SDPA/Python allocation or measured kernel. No Q/K norm, biased fused QKV represented by three materialized split buffers, interleaved half-head RoPE, group-head preallocated K/V state (NOT source cat/repack allocation), explicit full-head K/V activation expansion. Full-M RoPE construction proxy, shared bool mask, FP32 score/probability and BF16 cast are authored materialization choices; SDPA backend could fuse them. No eager per-layer QK scaling (the selected SDPA override bypasses it), dropout/training, padding, runtime/network or actual kernel precision claim. FP32 vector proxies: RMSNorm5/element, SiLU6/element, rotary3/rotated element; BF16 matrix separately. LAST=0 full logits (forward default), LAST=1 last position (generation uses it). Per-buffer HBM read/write factor1, each weight read once per leaf. See references/models/expansion-source-lock.json; no Python execution or model weights.
